name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is an old age income security scheme for savings account holders in the age group of 18-40 years who are not income-tax payees. The scheme addresses longevity risks among workers in the unorganized sector and encourages voluntary retirement savings.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000 per month after attaining 60 years.
Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹2,000 per month after attaining 60 years.
Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹3,000 per month after attaining 60 years.
Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹4,000 per month after attaining 60 years.
Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹5,000 per month after attaining 60 years.
After the subscriber's death, the spouse is entitled to receive the same pension amount until the spouse's death.
After both subscriber and spouse die, the nominee is entitled to receive the accumulated pension wealth.
Contributions are eligible for tax benefits similar to NPS under section 80CCD(1).
In voluntary exit before 60, contributions plus net actual accrued income may be refunded after applicable account maintenance charges, subject to the source's stated conditions.

In case of death before 60, the spouse may continue the APY account for the remaining vesting period or the accumulated pension corpus may be returned to the spouse or nominee, according to the available options.

rules.description: Minimum age of joining APY is 18 years.
Maximum age of joining APY is 40 years.
APY is for savings account holders; contributions are made through auto-debit from the subscriber's savings bank account.

exclusion_rules.description: From 1 October 2022, any citizen who is or has been an income tax payer is not eligible to join APY.

tutorial_steps.title: Login to internet banking
tutorial_steps.description: Login to the applicant's internet banking account.

tutorial_steps.title: Search for APY
tutorial_steps.description: Search for Atal Pension Yojana on the banking dashboard.

tutorial_steps.title: Fill basic and nominee details
tutorial_steps.description: Fill in basic details and nominee details.

tutorial_steps.title: Give consent for auto-debit
tutorial_steps.description: Give consent for auto-debit of the prescribed contribution amount.

tutorial_steps.title: Select Atal Pension Yojana
tutorial_steps.description: Select 'Atal Pension Yojana' from the available options.

tutorial_steps.title: Select APY Registration
tutorial_steps.description: Select 'APY Registration' to begin the registration process.

tutorial_steps.title: Fill basic details
tutorial_steps.description: Fill in basic details as required.

tutorial_steps.title: Complete KYC
tutorial_steps.description: Complete KYC using one of the three options: Offline KYC using Aadhaar XML, Aadhaar OTP verification on the mobile number registered with Aadhaar, or Virtual ID.

tutorial_steps.title: Record acknowledgement number
tutorial_steps.description: After basic details are completed, record the generated acknowledgement number.

tutorial_steps.title: Select desired pension amount
tutorial_steps.description: Select the desired pension amount after age 60.

tutorial_steps.title: Select contribution frequency
tutorial_steps.description: Select contribution frequency: monthly, quarterly, or half-yearly.

tutorial_steps.title: Confirm details
tutorial_steps.description: Confirm personal details and nominee details.

tutorial_steps.title: Continue to eSign
tutorial_steps.description: Continue to eSign on the NSDL website.

tutorial_steps.title: Complete Aadhaar OTP verification
tutorial_steps.description: Complete Aadhaar OTP verification to finalize registration.

tutorial_steps.title: Registration completed
tutorial_steps.description: APY registration is completed. Citizens may also join digitally through the e-APY portal or through web portals of banks providing such facility.
